Name: Sliver
Description: Before becoming a member of the new Euroforce, Franco Fibbri was a famous soccer player, stated as "the most paid soccer player in the world". When he retire, he spent all his money on a dangerous project to imbue himself with strange and unidentified alien substance which transformed him into the golden compound being. He take the battle name of Sliver.
